title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-05-12
content:
Release Engineering meeting notes
Date: 2026-05-12
Attendees: Ethan Chen (owner), Priya Desai, Marco Alvarez, Lina Park, Ruth Kim, Dan O'Neill (SRE), Anya Patel (PM)

1) Quick status updates
- Current release train: v1.8.0 scheduled for 2026-05-19 (regular cadence). Code freeze: 2026-05-16 23:59 UTC.
- Hotfix in flight: payments-edge-hotfix (JIRA-RE-2345). Targeting patch release v1.7.3 by EOD 2026-05-13. Root cause: race condition in payment retry backoff; reproduces in smoke harness.
- CI flakiness: flaky test suite on gpu-integration jobs increased from 2% -> 8% failure rate last week. Primary suspects: long-running tensor allocation test and a new concurrency test merged in PR #401.

2) Release train details and logistics
- v1.8.0 scope: batching improvements (PRs #405, #409), canary routing policy update to enable regional fallbacks, minor API schema bump (backwards-compatible). No model weights changes.
- Canary window: 30% traffic for 2 hours, then 60% for 2 hours, full rollout if latency and error budgets are within thresholds. Canary metric thresholds: p95 latency < 220ms, error rate < 0.5% for generation endpoints, CPU/GPU utilization within expected bounds.
- Rollout owners: canary run owned by Priya Desai; rollback decision owned by SRE (Dan O'Neill) with input from Priya and Marco.
- Release window: 2026-05-19 02:00-06:00 UTC to avoid peak egress in NA.

3) Hotfix (payments-edge-hotfix) plan
- Action: ship patch v1.7.3 containing backoff mutex fix and an additional unit test. Owner: Marco Alvarez. ETA: 2026-05-13 18:00 UTC.
- Canary for hotfix: internal traffic only for 30 minutes, smoke tests + payment E2E with sandbox keys. Owner: Marco.
- Rollback criteria for hotfix: any failed payment E2E or increase in payment error rate > 0.2% over baseline within 1 hour.
- Post-deploy: collect payment latency histograms and error traces for 24 hours; schedule short postmortem if rollback occurs.

4) CI and flaky tests
- Action: quarantine flaky gpu-integration tests and create replacements. Owner: Lina Park. ETA: 2026-05-15.
- Action: revert the concurrency test in PR #401 temporarily until we validate stability on dedicated pools. Owner: Ethan Chen. ETA: 2026-05-13 morning.
- Add a CI health dashboard widget to track 7d rolling flakiness and median build times. Owner: Ruth Kim. ETA: 2026-05-18.

5) Change log items (for v1.8.0 release notes)
- Improvements: continuous batching heuristics tuned for short-sequence workloads; reduced per-token overhead in high-concurrency scenarios.
- Ops: canary routing policy update to support automatic regional fallback when latency exceeds SLO.
- Fixes: memory leak fix in kv-cache eviction path (cherry-picked from release branch).
- Note: payments patch v1.7.3 to be released separately as an emergency patch.

6) Canary metrics & observability checklist
- Confirm metrics present in Prometheus: request_latency_ms (p50/p95/p99), request_errors_total (by route), kv_cache_hit_rate, batch_size_distribution. Responsible: Priya Desai.
- Tracing: ensure sampled traces capture model variant and route_tag. Responsible: Marco Alvarez.
- Logs: add structured fields for release_tag and canary=true during canary window. Responsible: Lina Park.
- Automated alert: if p95 latency increases by >15% vs baseline for 10 consecutive minutes during rollout, trigger rollback. Owner: SRE (Dan O'Neill).

7) Rollback and fallback policies
- Automatic fallback: traffic will shift to last-known-good model variant and hosted-region fallback after two consecutive canary windows failing thresholds.
- Manual rollback: SRE may trigger full rollback if any critical customer-impacting errors observed. Communication: notify #release-engineering and on-call pager.

8) Action items (owners & due dates)
- Marco Alvarez: Merge and ship payments-edge-hotfix (JIRA-RE-2345) and run hotfix canary. Due: 2026-05-13 18:00 UTC.
- Ethan Chen: Revert PR #401 concurrency test from mainline and open a follow-up PR to stabilize. Due: 2026-05-13 11:00 UTC.
- Lina Park: Quarantine flaky gpu-integration tests and draft replacement tests. Due: 2026-05-15.
- Priya Desai: Prepare canary runbook, checklist, and dashboard panels for v1.8.0 rollout. Due: 2026-05-17.
- Ruth Kim: Add CI health dashboard widget and notify engineering leads when flakiness exceeds threshold. Due: 2026-05-18.
- Dan O'Neill: Validate rollback playbook and update runbook with new rollback triggers. Due: 2026-05-16.

9) Risks & open questions
- Risk: if hotfix uncovers other race paths, we may need a short freeze on dependent releases. Mitigation: prioritize additional tests and a fast follow-up patch.
- Question: Do we want to expand canary timeframe to 4 hours at 30% for regionally-sensitive customers? Decision deferred; PM (Anya Patel) to advise by 2026-05-14.

10) Meeting cadence and next meeting
- Weekly release engineering sync remains Tuesdays 09:30 UTC. Ad-hoc standups for hotfixes as needed.
- Next meeting: 2026-05-19 (post-release readout) unless hotfix triggers an earlier postmortem.

Notes & references:
- See linked artifacts for PRs and JIRA tickets.
- Slack thread: #release-engineering for real-time updates.

End of notes.
